primary_accuracy: New cohort only: baseline minus TabPFN augmentation loss, equal weight across both noise levels and all three fractions, then seeds and datasets. Report each baseline separately.
primary_timing: Original six tasks: paired augmented/clean fit+first-predict ratios, median trials then mean seeds then equal datasets. Report every fraction and noise ratio.
secondary: Half-training/full-noise contrast, all condition-specific contrasts, absolute BA, absolute times, first and repeated prediction times, failures.
inference: Descriptive; no significance claims or seed-as-dataset inference. Original cohort is exploratory; prospective new cohort is not publicly preregistered.
family_rule: Retain only the first eligible mfeat variant; otherwise one dataset per case-insensitive OpenML name. Further unrecognized family dependence remains a limitation.
